words.definition: a place where children go to learn
words.example: I go to school every morning.

words.definition: a person whose job is to teach students
words.example: Our teacher is very kind.

words.definition: a person who is learning at a school or college
words.example: Every student must bring a book.

words.definition: a room in a school where lessons happen
words.example: We sit at desks in the classroom.

words.definition: a set of printed pages with a cover, used for reading
words.example: I forgot my book at home.

words.definition: a tool used for writing with ink
words.example: Can I borrow your pen, please?

words.definition: a tool used for writing or drawing, usually made of wood
words.example: She draws pictures with a pencil.

words.definition: schoolwork that a student does at home
words.example: I do my homework after dinner.

words.definition: a period of time when a student learns about a subject
words.example: Today's lesson is about animals.

words.definition: to get new knowledge or a new skill
words.example: I want to learn English well.

words.definition: to help someone learn something
words.example: My father taught me to read.

words.definition: to spend time learning about a subject
words.example: We study math every day.

words.definition: to look at words and understand their meaning
words.example: I read a new book every week.

words.definition: to make letters or words on paper
words.example: Please write your name here.

words.definition: a sentence that asks for information
words.example: The teacher asked a difficult question.

words.definition: a reply to a question
words.example: I did not know the answer.

words.definition: a formal test of knowledge
words.example: We have an exam next week.

words.definition: an area of knowledge that you study, like math or history
words.example: Math is my favorite subject.

words.definition: a person you know well and like
words.example: I sit next to my friend in class.

words.definition: not easy; hard to do or understand
words.example: This lesson is very difficult for me.

text: Every morning, I go to school with my friend. My favorite subject is math, but it is sometimes difficult for me. My teacher is very kind. She teaches us new lessons every day and helps us learn new things. In the classroom, I sit next to my friend, and we study together. I always bring a pen, a pencil, and my books to school. Yesterday, our teacher asked a question about history, but nobody knew the answer. She explained the lesson again, and now I understand it better. Every student in my class must do homework after school. Sometimes the homework is easy, but sometimes it is very difficult. Next week, we have an exam, so I need to study hard and read my books carefully. I like to write notes during the lesson because it helps me remember. My teacher says that if we work hard, we will pass the exam. I want to learn many new things this year and become a good student.
